arabic text: RONAY KEY LIYE KAAFI HAI SAJAAD TERA NAAM\nTU SHEHENSHAHAI DARD HAI BATLA RAHI HAI SHAAM
english translation text: Sajjad—your name alone is enough to make one weep.\nShaam bears witness that you are the king of suffering.

arabic text:
CHALA BEKASON KA KARAWAN, BEEMAR LOGO
SARABAN
HAI SANG SAR-E, URIYAN, SHAH-E-LAFATAA KI BETIYAN
KARBOBALA KAI DASHT MAIN BARPA HUWA KOHRAAM
english translation text:
The caravan of the helpless moved on, led by the ailing one.
Stones struck the bare heads
of the daughters of the Lion of God.
An uproar filled the desert of Karbala.

arabic text:
ZAINAB PUKARAI BEWATAN, BHAI MERA HAI
BEKAFAN
KARDEY USSAI KO-I DAFAN, MERE HATHON MAIN BAN-
DHI RASAN
HAI KEYSE SUNA HOGA, BEEMAR NE PAIGHAM
english translation text:
The exiled Zainab cried: ‘My brother lies
without a shroud.
Someone bury him—my hands are
bound in ropes.’
How must the ailing Imam have received that message?

arabic text:
KATJATE SAIYADON KE SAR, ZAINAB NA JATI DAR-BA-
DAR
BEEMAR KA TUKRE JIGAR, ROWTA HAI LAHOO, HAR
NAZAR
HEY MANZILON PEY,TARAPNA,SAJAAD TERA KAAM
english translation text:
Had the Sayyids’ heads not been severed, Zainab would not have gone door to
door.
The ailing Imam, with a shattered heart, weeps blood through every
gaze.
At every stage of the journey, Sajjad, suffering became your task.

arabic text:
MASTOORON MEIN IK MARD HAI, GHEYRAT SE
CHEH’RA ZARD HAI
KARBAL KI JAMI, GARD HAI, ZAINAB KA DIL MEIN,
DARD HAI
ROWTA HAI SAR JHUKA KE, KARTA NAHIN KALAAM
english translation text:
Among the veiled ladies, only one man remained; from anguish,
his face had turned pale.
The dust of Karbala covered him, while Zainab’s sorrow
filled his heart.
He wept with lowered head and could not speak.

arabic text:
MUSHKIL THI BARI, VO GHARI, DARBAR MAIN ZAI,
NAB KHARI
SHAH-E-DEEN KE LAB PE CHHARI, SAJAAD NE PEH’-NI
KARI
DARBAAR-E-YAZEEDI KE, LARZE THEY DAR-O-BAAM
english translation text:
That moment in the court was unbearably difficult, when Zainab
stood before the tyrant.
A staff struck the lips of the King of Faith, and Sajjad bore a heavy
collar.
The walls and doors of Yazid’s court trembled.

arabic text:
ZINDAAN SIAH, POWSH HAI, TAHAI KI AA,GHOWSH
HAI
ABID KA HERAN, HOWSH HAI, DAM TOOTA HAI KHA-
MOWSH HAI
UMAT NE SAKINA KO, DIYA MOWT KA INAAM
english translation text:
The dark prison enclosed them in
loneliness. Abid stood stunned and bewildered;
his breath broke as he
remained silent. The nation gave
Sakina death as its reward.
